name: novnc

check.cmd: hash x11vnc > /dev/null 2>&1 && [ -d ~/.novnc ] && [ -d ~/.vnc ] && echo installed || echo uninstall

launch: echo -e "88888888\n88888888" | vncpasswd -f > ~/.vnc/passwd && sudo cp -f ~/.vnc/passwd /etc/.vnc/passwd && ( systemctl is-active x11vnc > /dev/null 2>&1 && sudo systemctl restart x11vnc || sudo systemctl start x11vnc) && sleep 6 && ~/.novnc/utils/novnc_proxy

description.zh: 远程桌面：可以登陆RDK设备桌面进行操作（密码8个8）
description.en: noVNC: Use VNC in RDK Studio (Password: 88888888)
